summary: Thomson Reuters filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 17, 2026, covering a debt offering by subsidiary TR Finance LLC. Under a September 10, 2026 prospectus supplement filed on the joint Form F-10/F-3 registration statements, TR Finance issued US$800 million of 5.100% notes due 2028 and US$500 million of 5.750% notes due 2033, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Thomson Reuters and subsidiary guarantors. The notes were issued under a March 20, 2025 base indenture and a September 17, 2026 sixth supplemental indenture, with Computershare and Deutsche Bank as trustees. This routine investment-grade bond takedown is not a special situation. Watch future debt maturities and refinancing terms.
